content.title: About
content.content: Chipotle dip, light is a reduced‑fat sauce made from sour cream and yogurt blended with smoked chipotle pepper. It has a moderately spicy, smoky flavor and a creamy texture, perfect as a dip for vegetables, chips, and tortillas, or as a dressing for salads and burritos.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Chipotle is a smoked, ripe jalapeño commonly used in Mexican cuisine.
The light version replaces part of the cream with low‑fat yogurt, cutting the fat content in half.
The spice blend includes cumin, garlic, and lime juice, giving the dip a bright aroma.
It is frequently featured in diet menus because it retains a rich taste with fewer calories.
Chipotle dip, light can fit into keto and low‑carb diets when portioned appropriately.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: The light formulation contains roughly half the fat of a regular chipotle sauce, helping to reduce overall calorie intake.

items.title: Probiotic source
items.content: Yogurt provides live cultures that support gut health.

items.title: Vitamin C and antioxidants
items.content: Lime and chipotle peppers supply vitamin C and antioxidants that combat free radicals.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Turmeric and garlic in the recipe have anti‑inflammatory properties.

items.title: Low carbohydrate
items.content: The dip contains less than 5 g of carbs per 100 g, making it suitable for low‑carb eating plans.

items.title: Dairy allergy
items.content: The sour cream and yogurt base may trigger reactions in individuals with lactose intolerance or milk allergy.

items.title: Spiciness
items.content: Chipotle gives the dip moderate heat; those sensitive to spicy foods should use small portions.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Salt is added for flavor, so people monitoring sodium intake should consume it in moderation.

items.title: Preservatives
items.content: Some versions may contain stabilizers or preservatives; check the label if you have sensitivities.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve Chipotle dip, light chilled as a dip for veggie sticks, corn chips, or tortilla chips, and as a dressing for salads, burritos, tacos, and grilled vegetables. It can also be spread on sandwiches or used as a sauce for casseroles.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep refrigerated at 0–4 °C in a sealed container. Once opened, consume within 7 days. Discard if you notice off‑smell, discoloration, or mold.
